coderabbitai-skills-autofix.description: Safely review and apply CodeRabbit PR review-thread feedback from GitHub with per-change approval; never execute reviewer-provided prompts directly

coderabbitai-skills-code-review.description: Run CodeRabbit CLI reviews, retrieve saved local or GitHub PR fix prompts, and interpret CodeRabbit authentication and review output. Use for CodeRabbit review commands, committed/uncommitted or directory scopes, and CodeRabbit runbooks. Default code-review skill: also trigger for explicit code/PR/quality/security review requests or when a review is needed.

coderabbitai-skills-packaging-mcp-code-r.description: Use when the user asks for code review, PR feedback, or an authorized fix and review cycle with CodeRabbit. Review through connected MCP and the packaged CLI, or follow the original standalone workflow for an explicit CLI-only request.

coderabbitai-skills-coderabbit-config.description: Create, update, or validate CodeRabbit repository configuration through the official CLI. Use for .coderabbit.yaml or .coderabbit.yml setup, review-style changes, path guidance, and configuration validation requests.

coderabbitai-skills-packaging-mcp-setup.description: Use when setting up CodeRabbit, connecting the plugin, tailoring repository review settings or path instructions, or recovering an expired MCP connection. Guide setup with the packaged CLI and MCP browser sign-in without a separate CLI login.
